slots.description: Slot for any content that should be placed beside the file icon and file name. If several elements is placed, they will be spaced evenly, for more information see https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/CSS/justify-content.

slots.description: Slot for any type of content. Elements placed in this slot will be position after the file icon and file name.
